quests.title: Echoes of the Unknown Gate
quests.summary: Uncover the ancient harmonic mystery linking the Crossroads, the Heart Tree, and the sealed Unknown Gate at the frontier.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Maren at the Crossroads Settlement
Journey west and discover The Ancient Heart Tree
Awaken the Singing Obelisk puzzle in the valley ruins
Attune 3 Regional Waystones across the realm
Discover The Unknown Gate in the Hidden Frontier

quests.title: Awakening the Unknown Gate
quests.summary: Confront the Gatekeeper Automaton in the Hidden Frontier, claim its Aether Core, and awaken the monumental Unknown Gate.

objectives.text: Defeat the Elder Stone Warden guarding the frontier
Awaken The Unknown Gate portal with the Resonance Key

quests.title: Herbs of the Emerald Canopy
quests.summary: Herbalist Lyra seeks luminous Moonpetals and Golden Sunberries to brew traveling tonics.

objectives.text: Gather Golden Sunberries (3)
Gather Silver Moonpetals from the forest edge (2)
Report back to Herbalist Lyra

quests.title: Forge of the Old Kingdom
quests.summary: Blacksmith Torin can teach you to craft ancient weaponry once you recover sentinel parts and crystals.

objectives.text: Defeat a Stone Sentinel or Bramble Stalker
Collect Resonant Crystal Shards (2)
Craft any item or meal via Inventory -> Crafting

quests.title: Sails of the Azure Coast
quests.summary: Harbormaster Kael at Tidehaven Harbor challenges you to sail across Azure Coast and dive for a Sunken Pearl near the Drowned Archive.

objectives.text: Take the helm of a Sailboat on Azure Coast
Discover The Drowned Archive
Recover a Drowned Archive Pearl from the seabed

quests.title: Ascent of the Skywatch Peaks
quests.summary: Alpine Guide Soren at Frostcrest Basecamp asks you to gather Frostblooms and climb to the rotating Skywatch Observatory.

objectives.text: Harvest Highland Frostblooms (2)
Reach The Skywatch Observatory

quests.title: The Cartographer's Horizon
quests.summary: Chart the diverse regions of the 8x8 km realm and uncover ancient landmarks & environmental puzzles hidden across the continent.

objectives.text: Discover 4 Major Regional Landmarks
Solve 3 Ancient Environmental Puzzles

quests.title: Secrets of the Hidden Sanctuaries
quests.summary: Venture inside ancient enclosed sanctuaries across the realm — Elder's Hall, the Crystal Vault, and the Drowned Archive Chamber.

objectives.text: Enter 2 Interior Sanctuaries or Halls
Vanquish a Legendary Regional Guardian Boss
